queries.test: select * from s_configuration where id = [id] and name = [name]
queries.all_packages_old: SELECT s_packages.id,s_packages.package_code,s_packages.account_num,s_packages.package_type,s_packages.status,s_packages.reg_date, (select sum(total_amount) from nf_operations where package_id = s_packages.id) as amount,h_storages.name as storage_name, s_packages.change_date,s_packages.details,s_package_types.name type_id FROM s_packages LEFT JOIN h_storages ON s_packages.storage_id=h_storages.id, s_package_types where s_packages.package_type=s_package_types.id
queries.all_packages: select * from ( SELECT id,package_code,account_num,package_type,status,reg_date,amount,storage_name,storage_id,change_date,details,type_id,created_by, modified_by FROM ( SELECT s_packages.id,s_packages.package_code,s_packages.account_num,s_packages.package_type,s_packages.status,s_packages.reg_date, (select sum(total_amount) from nf_operations where package_id = s_packages.id) as amount,created_by, modified_by, ( select hs.name as storage_name from nf_operations no, h_storages hs where no.package_id = s_packages.id and hs.id = no.storage_id order by no.create_date limit 0,1) as storage_name, ( select no.storage_id as storage_name from nf_operations no, h_storages hs where no.package_id = s_packages.id and hs.id = no.storage_id order by no.create_date limit 0,1) as storage_id, s_packages.change_date,s_packages.details,s_package_types.name type_id FROM s_packages, s_package_types WHERE s_packages.package_type=s_package_types.id ) l JOIN (select resource_id from grants where id in ( select grant_id from user_grants where user_id in ( select id from users where login ='[login]' ) and grant_id is not null union all select grant_id from role_grants where role_id in (select role_id from user_grants where user_id in (select id from users where login='[login]') and role_id is not null) ) and resource_type = 'h_storages' and grant_type = 'GET' ) m ON l.storage_id = m.resource_id) s_packages where 1=1
queries.packages_by_type: SELECT s_packages.id,s_package_types.name type,s_packages.status,s_packages.reg_date,s_packages.details FROM s_packages,s_package_types WHERE s_packages.package_type = s_package_types.id and package_type in ([package_type]) order by s_packages.reg_date desc
queries.selling_nf_operations: select nf_operations.id id, h_items.item_name, nf_operations.count,nf_operations.total_amount,nf_operations.reg_date,nf_operations.change_date,nf_operations.details from h_items,nf_operations where h_items.id in (select item_id from h_items_info where id = nf_operations.item_id) and nf_operations.package_id = [package_id]

queries.clearing_nf_operations: select nf_operations.id id, h_items.item_name,h_storages.name storage, nf_operations.count,nf_operations.reg_date,nf_operations.change_date,nf_operations.details from h_items,nf_operations,h_storages where (h_items.id,h_storages.id) in (select item_id,storage_id from h_items_info where id = nf_operations.item_id) and nf_operations.package_id = [package_id]

queries.cashdesk_nf_operations: select nf_operations.id id, h_items.item_name, nf_operations.count,nf_operations.total_amount,nf_operations.reg_date,nf_operations.change_date,nf_operations.details from h_items,nf_operations where h_items.id in (select item_id from h_items_info where id = nf_operations.item_id) and nf_operations.package_id = [package_id]
queries.income_nf_operations: select nf_operations.id id, h_contractors.name, h_contractors.last_name, h_items.item_name, nf_operations.price, nf_operations.count,nf_operations.total_amount,nf_operations.reg_date,nf_operations.change_date,nf_operations.details from h_items,nf_operations,h_contractors where h_items.id in ( select item_id from h_items_info where id = nf_operations.item_id ) and h_contractors.id = (select reg_num from f_accounts where account_num = nf_operations.sender) and nf_operations.package_id = [package_id]

queries.clearing_crud: SELECT nf_operations.id, t2.item_name, t3.name, nf_operations.count FROM nf_operations, h_items t2, h_items_info t4, h_storages t3 WHERE nf_operations.storage_id=t3.id AND nf_operations.item_id = t4.id AND t4.item_id = t2.id AND nf_operations.package_id =[package_id]
queries.income_crud: SELECT nf_operations.id, nf_operations.item_name, t2.name, nf_operations.count, nf_operations.price, nf_operations.sell_price, nf_operations.vat, nf_operations.vat_amount FROM nf_operations, h_storages t2 WHERE nf_operations.storage_id = t2.id AND nf_operations.package_id =[package_id]

queries.migration_crud: SELECT nf_operations.id, t2.item_name, t3.name, nf_operations.count FROM nf_operations, h_items t2, h_storages t3, h_items_info t4 WHERE nf_operations.storage_id=t3.id AND nf_operations.item_id = t4.id AND t4.item_id = t2.id AND nf_operations.package_id = [package_id]
queries.returns_crud: SELECT nf_operations.id, t2.item_name, concat(h_contractors.name,' ',h_contractors.last_name) as contractor, t3.name, nf_operations.total_amount, nf_operations.count FROM nf_operations, h_items t2, h_storages t3, h_items_info t4, h_contractors WHERE nf_operations.storage_id=t3.id AND nf_operations.item_id = t4.id AND t4.item_id = t2.id AND h_contractors.id = (select reg_num from f_accounts where account_num = nf_operations.receiver) AND nf_operations.package_id = [package_id]
queries.reservation_crud: SELECT nf_operations.id, t2.item_name, concat(h_contractors.name,' ',h_contractors.last_name) as contractor, t3.name, nf_operations.count FROM nf_operations, h_items t2, h_storages t3, h_items_info t4, h_contractors WHERE nf_operations.storage_id=t3.id AND nf_operations.item_id = t4.id AND t4.item_id = t2.id AND h_contractors.id = nf_operations.respondent_id AND nf_operations.package_id = [package_id]
queries.selling_crud: SELECT nf_operations.id, t2.item_name, t3.name, nf_operations.price, nf_operations.count, nf_operations.total_amount FROM nf_operations, h_items t2, h_storages t3, h_items_info t4 WHERE t4.storage_id=t3.id AND nf_operations.item_id = t4.id AND t4.item_id = t2.id AND nf_operations.package_id = [package_id]
queries.itemslist: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT m.id, m.item_name, m.item_code, m.ean_number, m.storage_name, ti.name as 'category_name', m.measure_id, m.measure_name, m.price , m.currency_code, m.sell_price, SUM(m.count) as count, SUM(m.reserved) as reserved FROM ( SELECT t3.id, t1.item_name, t3.item_code, t3.ean_number, t2.name as 'storage_name', t1.category_id, t3.measure_id, t4.name AS measure_name, t3.price, t3.currency_code, t3.sell_price, t3.count, getReservedCountByItemIdAndStorageId(t3.item_id,t3.storage_id) AS reserved FROM h_items t1,h_items_info t3, h_storages t2, s_measures t4 WHERE t3.measure_id = t4.id AND t3.item_id = t1.id AND t3.storage_id = t2.id AND EXISTS (select * FROM nf_operations where item_id=t3.id and storage_id = t2.id ) AND t1.status != "RE" ) m LEFT JOIN s_item_categories ti ON m.category_id = ti.id GROUP BY m.id) n where 1
queries.operation_rule: select * from ( select id, payment_type_id, operation_type_id, case when credit like ('^[%]$') then (select value from s_configuration where name = trim(TRAILING ']$' from trim(LEADING '^[' from credit)) ) else credit end as credit_val, case when debet like ('^[%]$') then (select value from s_configuration where name = trim(TRAILING ']$' from trim(LEADING '^[' from debet)) ) else debet end as debet_val from s_operation_rules ) as val_table where '[debet]' regexp debet_val and '[credit]' regexp credit_val and payment_type_id = [payment_type_id] and operation_type_id = [operation_type_id]
queries.transaction_rules: select * from ( select id, case when credit like ('^[%]$') then (select value from s_configuration where name = trim(TRAILING ']$' from trim(LEADING '^[' from credit)) ) else credit end as credit_val, case when debet like ('^[%]$') then (select value from s_configuration where name = trim(TRAILING ']$' from trim(LEADING '^[' from debet)) ) else debet end as debet_val, cn_flag, amount,operation_rule_id,currency_code from s_transaction_rules ) as val_table where operation_rule_id = [operation_rule_id]
queries.check_package_id: select IF(status > 1, 0, 1) as editable from s_packages where id = [package_id] and package_type = [package_type]
queries.get_main_currency: select id, code, value from s_currencies where is_main = 1
queries.get_currency_details: select id, code, name, value, is_main from s_currencies where code = '[code]' and effective_date <= '[effective_date]' order by effective_date desc limit 0,1
queries.get_account_type: select type from f_accounts where account_num='[account_num]'
queries.get_items_json: SELECT t1.id AS `id` , ifnull(t3.id, 0) AS `item_info_id`, t2.name AS `category` , t3.package_id AS `package_id` , t3.reg_date AS `reg_date` , t3.count AS `count` , t3.price AS `price` , t3.sell_price AS `sell_price` , t1.category_id, t1.item_name AS `name` , t4.name AS `measure_name` , ifnull(t3.limit_cnt,0) AS limit_cnt, ifnull(t5.id, 0) AS `storage_id`, ifnull(t5.name,'') AS `storage`, t3.currency_code FROM h_items t1 LEFT JOIN h_items_info t3 ON t1.id = t3.item_id LEFT JOIN s_measures t4 ON t3.measure_id = t4.id LEFT JOIN h_storages t5 ON t5.id = t3.storage_id, s_item_categories t2 WHERE t1.category_id = t2.id AND t1.status!='RE' AND (lower(t1.item_name) like lower('%[param]%') OR t3.item_code like('%[param]%') OR lower(t1.details) like lower('%[param]%') OR t1.ean_number like('%[param]%') OR lower(t2.name) like lower('%[param]%') OR t1.id like('%[param]%')) group by t1.id , t3.storage_id
queries.get_items_counted_sold_json:

AND t3.id in ( select item_id from nf_operations where operation_type_id in (3,5) ) AND (lower(t1.item_name) like lower('%[param]%') OR t3.item_code like('%[param]%') OR t1.details like('%[param]%') OR t1.ean_number like('%[param]%') OR t1.details like('%[param]%') OR lower(t2.name) like lower('%[param]%') OR t1.id like('%[param]%')) group by t3.id, t1.id , t3.storage_id ) l
queries.get_items_counted_json: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT t3.id AS `id` , t1.id AS 'h_item_id', t2.name AS `category` , t3.package_id AS `package_id` , MIN(t3.reg_date) AS `reg_date` , t3.count AS `count` , t3.price AS `price` , t3.sell_price AS `sell_price` , t1.category_id, t1.item_name AS `name` , t4.name AS `measure_name` , t4.id AS `measure_id`, t3.limit_cnt, t3.storage_id, t5.name AS `storage`, t3.currency_code, t3.ean_number AS `ean_number` FROM h_items t1, h_items_info t3, s_item_categories t2, s_measures t4, h_storages t5 WHERE t3.measure_id = t4.id AND t1.status!='RE' AND t5.id = t3.storage_id AND t3.storage_id!=2 AND t1.id = t3.item_id AND t1.category_id = t2.id AND t3.count > 0 AND (lower(t1.item_name) like lower('%[param]%') OR t3.item_code like('%[param]%') OR t1.details like('%[param]%') OR t1.ean_number like('%[param]%') OR t1.details like('%[param]%') OR lower(t2.name) like lower('%[param]%') OR t1.id like('%[param]%')) group by t1.id , t3.storage_id ) l
queries.get_items_by_id_storage: SELECT t3.id AS `id` , t1.id AS 'h_item_id', t2.name AS `category` , t3.package_id AS `package_id` , t3.reg_date AS `reg_date` , t3.count AS `count` , t3.price AS `price` , t3.sell_price AS `sell_price` , t1.category_id, t1.item_name AS `name` , t4.name AS `measure_name` , t4.id AS `measure_id` , t3.limit_cnt, t3.storage_id, t5.name AS `storage`, t3.currency_code FROM h_items t1, h_items_info t3, s_item_categories t2, s_measures t4, h_storages t5 WHERE t3.measure_id = t4.id AND t1.status!='RE' AND t5.id = t3.storage_id AND t1.id = t3.item_id AND t1.category_id = t2.id AND t3.count > 0 AND t1.id = [item_id] AND t3.storage_id = [storage_id] ORDER BY t3.reg_date
queries.get_items_info_json: SELECT t3.id AS `id` , t1.id AS 'h_item_id', t2.name AS `category` , t3.package_id AS `package_id` , t3.reg_date AS `reg_date` , t3.count AS `count` , t3.price AS `price` , t3.sell_price AS `sell_price` , t1.category_id, t1.item_name AS `name` , t4.name AS `measure_name` , t3.limit_cnt, t3.storage_id, t5.name AS `storage`, t3.currency_code FROM h_items t1, h_items_info t3, s_item_categories t2, s_measures t4, h_storages t5 WHERE t3.measure_id = t4.id AND t1.status!='RE' AND t5.id = t3.storage_id AND t1.id = t3.item_id AND t1.category_id = t2.id AND t3.count > 0 AND (lower(t1.item_name) like lower('%[param]%') OR t3.item_code like('%[param]%') OR t1.details like('%[param]%') OR t1.ean_number like('%[param]%') OR t1.details like('%[param]%') OR lower(t2.name) like lower('%[param]%') OR t1.id like('%[param]%'))
queries.get_items_categories_json: select id, name, (select name from s_item_categories t2 where t2.id = t1.parent_id) as parent_name from s_item_categories t1 where status != "RE" and (name like('%[param]%') or details like('%[param]%'))
queries.get_storages_json: SELECT * FROM ( select id,name, id as storage_id from h_storages where lower(name) like lower('%[param]%') and status!='RE' and id not in (select value from s_configuration where name in ('return_storage_id','cleared_storage_id')) ) l

queries.get_invoices_json: SELECT * FROM ( select id, package_code, reg_date, package_type, status, account_num, (select storage_id from nf_operations where package_id = s.id order by create_date limit 0,1) as storage_id , (select sum(total_amount) from nf_operations where package_id = s.id) as amount from s_packages s where (id like ('%[param]%') or reg_date like ('%[param]%') or package_code like ('%[param]%')) and [where] ) l

queries.get_count_by_h_item_id: select ifnull(SUM(count),-9999) `count` from h_items_info where item_id=[hitem_id] and storage_id = [storage_id]
queries.get_count_by_item_id_reserved: select ifnull(SUM(count),-9999) `count` from nf_operations where [where] and operation_type_id in (1,2) and status = 'AC'
queries.check_package_counts: select * from (SELECT item_id, case when s_packages.package_type = 1 then if (SUM(nf_operations.count) > 0,getCountByItemIdAndStorageId(item_id,nf_operations.storage_id) - getInventarisedCountByItemIdAndStorageIdAndContractorId(item_id,nf_operations.storage_id,0)-SUM( nf_operations.count ),SUM(nf_operations.count)+getInventarisedCountByItemIdAndStorageIdAndContractorId (item_id,nf_operations.storage_id,nf_operations.respondent_id)) when s_packages.package_type = 4 then if (SUM(nf_operations.count) > 0,getCountByItemIdAndStorageId(item_id,nf_operations.storage_id) - getReservedCountByItemIdAndStorageIdAndContractorId(item_id,nf_operations.storage_id,0)-SUM( nf_operations.count ),SUM(nf_operations.count)+getReservedCountByItemIdAndStorageIdAndContractorId (item_id,nf_operations.storage_id,nf_operations.respondent_id)) when s_packages.package_type = 8 or s_packages.package_type=2 or s_packages.package_type=3 then SUM(if(nf_operations.count < 0,nf_operations.count,0)) + getCountByItemIdAndStorageId(item_id,nf_operations.storage_id) else SUM( nf_operations.count ) + getCountByItemIdAndStorageId(item_id,nf_operations.storage_id) end as items FROM nf_operations, s_packages WHERE package_id =[package_id] AND s_packages.id = nf_operations.package_id AND s_packages.status = 1 GROUP BY item_id ) alias where items < 0
queries.copy_item_check: select t1.id from h_items t1, h_items t2 where t1.id <> t2.id and t1.item_code = t2.item_code and t1.item_name = t2.item_name and t1.category_id = t2.category_id and t1.storage_id <> t2.storage_id and t1.storage_id = [new_storage_id] and t2.id=[item_id]
queries.get_item_sell_price: select sell_price from h_items where id = [item_id]
queries.get_retail_debet_and_credit: select name,value from s_configuration where name = 'revenue' or name = 'company_[payment_type_id]'
queries.get_value_from_s_configuration: select name,value from s_configuration where name = '[name]'
queries.get_main_storage: select id,name from h_storages where is_main = 1
queries.get_currencies: select code from s_currencies where status != "RE" group by code order by code
queries.get_chart_of_accounts: select id,account_num,type,details from f_chart_of_accounts order by id
queries.get_payment_types: select id,name from s_payment_types where status != "RE"
queries.insert_items: insert into h_items_info select 0, item_id, item_code, ean_number, item_serial_number, [storage_id], price, sell_price, package_id, guarantee, expiration_date, reg_date, now(), currency_code, [count], measure_id, 0 from h_items_info where id = [item_id]
queries.update_items_count: update h_items_info set where id in (select item_id from nf_operations where package_id = [package_id]) select 0, item_id, item_code, storage_id, price, sell_price, package_id, guarantee, expiration_date, reg_date, now(), currency_code, count, 0, 0, measure_id, 0 from nf_operations where operation_type_id = 4 and package_id = [package_id]
queries.get_package_debt: SELECT ifnull((select sum(amount_ncur) FROM f_operations WHERE package_id = [package_id] AND credit like '[credit]'),0) - ifnull((select sum(amount_ncur) FROM f_operations WHERE package_id = [package_id] AND debet like '[debet]'),0) as debt FROM DUAL
queries.get_cashdesks: SELECT * FROM (SELECT c.id, c.account_num, ifnull((select sum(case when debet = c.account_num then amount_ncur when credit = c.account_num then -amount_ncur end) from f_transactions where status != 'RE' and debet = c.account_num or credit = c.account_num),0) balance, a.chart_account_num, c.name, c.details, ifnull(c.operator_name, '') operator_name, c.state, c.last_handover_user, c.last_accept_user, c.last_handover_date, c.last_accept_date, c.last_open_date, c.last_close_date , c.storage_id as storage_id FROM h_cashdesks c, f_accounts a WHERE (c.name like ('%[query]%') or c.details like ('%[query]%') or c.account_num like ('%[query]%')) and c.account_num = a.account_num and c.status != "RE" order by c.is_main desc ) l
queries.package_arhlog: SELECT a.id, a.reg_date, a.session_id, b.[lang] resource, c.[lang] type FROM (SELECT id, reg_date, session_id, table_name, case type when 'i' then 'inserted' when 'u' then 'updated' end type FROM arhlog where hash_group in (select distinct hash_group FROM arhlog where table_name = 's_packages' and conditions = 'id=[package_id]')) a, translations b, translations c WHERE c.row_id = 0 and b.field_name = a.table_name and c.row_id = 0 and c.field_name = a.type
queries.check_item_code: select item_code from h_items_info where item_code = '[item_code]' union all select item_code from nf_operations where item_code = '[item_code]' and item_code != ''
queries.get_accounts: select * from (SELECT f_accounts.id,f_accounts.reg_num,h_contractors.name,h_contractors.last_name,f_accounts.account_num, f_accounts.currency_code,f_accounts.bal_in_ncur,f_accounts.bal_out_ncur,f_accounts.bal_in_fcur, f_accounts.bal_out_fcur, f_accounts.type,f_accounts.reg_date,f_chart_of_accounts.details as `chart_of_accounts`, f_accounts.details, f_accounts.organisation_id, h_organisations.name org_name FROM f_accounts LEFT JOIN h_organisations ON f_accounts.organisation_id = h_organisations.id, f_chart_of_accounts, h_contractors WHERE f_accounts.chart_account_num = f_chart_of_accounts.account_num and h_contractors.reg_num = f_accounts.reg_num and f_accounts.status != 'RE') f_accounts where 1=1
queries.get_account_sub_num: select account_num,sub_num from f_chart_of_accounts where account_num = [account_num]
queries.check_account_type: SELECT * FROM `f_chart_of_accounts` where account_num = '[chart_of_account]' and type like('%[type]%')
queries.get_item_categories: select id,name from s_item_categories where status != "RE"
queries.get_measure_types: select id,name from s_measures where status != "RE"
queries.get_item_by_ean_number: select id,sell_price from h_items where ean_number='[ean_number]' and status != "RE"
queries.get_package_statuses: SELECT t1.id,statuses.[lang] name,t1.details,t1.status FROM s_package_statuses t1,translations statuses where t1.name = statuses.field_name and statuses.row_id = 0 and t1.status != "RE"
queries.get_package_types: SELECT t1.id,type.[lang] name,t1.details,t1.status FROM s_package_types t1,translations type where t1.name = type.field_name and type.row_id = 0 and t1.status != "RE"
queries.cashdesks: SELECT h_cashdesks.id, h_cashdesks.name, translations.[lang] cur_name, h_cashdesks.account_num, CONCAT(fa.account_num, ' - ', fa.details) account, h_cashdesks.details, h_cashdesks.is_main, h_cashdesks.status, h_cashdesks.storage_id, h_storages.name storage_name, ifnull((select sum(case when debet = fa.account_num then amount_ncur when credit = fa.account_num then -amount_ncur end) from f_transactions where status != 'RE' and debet = fa.account_num or credit = fa.account_num),0) balance FROM h_cashdesks LEFT JOIN f_accounts fa ON h_cashdesks.account_num = fa.account_num LEFT JOIN h_storages ON h_cashdesks.storage_id = h_storages.id, translations WHERE translations.row_id = h_cashdesks.id and translations.table_name = 'h_cashdesks' and translations.field_name = 'name' and h_cashdesks.status != "RE"
queries.check_if_storage_is_main: SELECT IF(is_main=1,(select min(id) from h_storages),'not_main') as 'response' from h_storages where id = [key] and status='AC'
queries.check_if_measure_is_main: SELECT IF(is_main=1,(select min(id) from s_measures),'not_main') as 'response' from s_measures where id = [key] and status='AC'
queries.dashboard_select_income: SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*),0) as answer FROM `nf_operations` WHERE 1 and `operation_type_id`=4 and reg_date > current_date-1
queries.dashboard_select_outgo: SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*),0) as answer FROM `nf_operations` WHERE 1 and `operation_type_id`=5 and reg_date > current_date-1
queries.dashboard_select_sales: SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*),0) as answer FROM `nf_operations` WHERE 1 and `operation_type_id`=3 and reg_date > current_date-1
queries.dashboard_select_inventarisation: SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*),0) as answer FROM `nf_operations` WHERE 1 and `operation_type_id`=6 and reg_date > current_date-1
queries.dashboard_notifications: SELECT `notifications`.icon, `translations`.[lang], `nf_operations`.reg_date FROM `notifications_config` , `notifications` , `nf_operations` , `translations` WHERE `notifications_config`.n_id = `notifications`.id and CURDATE() between `notifications_config`.start_date and `notifications_config`.end_date and `notifications_config`.hidden = 0 and `nf_operations`.operation_type_id = `notifications`.oper_type and `nf_operations`.reg_date is not NULL and `translations`.table_name = 'notifications' and `translations`.row_id = `notifications`.id ORDER BY `nf_operations`.reg_date DESC LIMIT 0,9
queries.notifications: SELECT `nf_operations`.id, `translations`.[lang] lang, `nf_operations`.reg_date FROM `notifications_config` , `notifications` , `nf_operations` , `translations` WHERE `notifications_config`.n_id = `notifications`.id and CURDATE() between `notifications_config`.start_date and `notifications_config`.end_date and `notifications_config`.hidden = 0 and `nf_operations`.operation_type_id = `notifications`.oper_type and `nf_operations`.reg_date is not NULL and `translations`.table_name = 'notifications' and `translations`.row_id = `notifications`.id ORDER BY `nf_operations`.reg_date DESC
queries.discount: SELECT discount.id, discount.name, discount.discount_desc, s_item_categories.name as category_name, hc.full_name , hi.item_name ,discount.count , discount.discount_card_code, discount.persent , discount.contragent, discount.item_category, discount.item FROM discount LEFT JOIN h_items hi ON discount.item =hi.id LEFT JOIN s_item_categories ON discount.item_category = s_item_categories.id LEFT JOIN ( select id, CONCAT( name, ' ', last_name, ' ', father_name ) as full_name from h_contractors) hc ON discount.contragent=hc.id
queries.invoice_header: SELECT s_packages.id,s_packages.package_type,s_package_types.name type_id,s_packages.status,s_packages.reg_date,s_packages.change_date,s_packages.details FROM s_packages, s_package_types where package_type = s_package_types.id and s_packages.id = [package_id]
queries.invoice_body: select nf_operations.id id,h_contractors.id contragent, h_contractors.name,h_contractors.last_name, h_items.item_name, nf_operations.count,nf_operations.reg_date,nf_operations.change_date,nf_operations.details from h_items,nf_operations,h_contractors where h_items.id in (select item_id from h_items_info where id = nf_operations.item_id) and nf_operations.package_id = [package_id] and h_contractors.id = nf_operations.sender
queries.expeditor_header: SELECT s_packages.id,s_packages.package_type,s_package_types.name type_id,s_packages.status,s_packages.reg_date,s_packages.change_date,s_packages.details FROM s_packages, s_package_types where package_type = s_package_types.id and s_packages.id = [package_id]
queries.expeditor_body: select h_items.item_name, nf_operations.count,nf_operations.reg_date from h_items,nf_operations where h_items.id in (select item_id from h_items_info where id = nf_operations.item_id) and nf_operations.package_id = [package_id] and nf_operations.count>0
queries.print_package: SELECT s_packages.id,s_packages.package_type,s_package_types.name type_id,s_packages.status,s_packages.reg_date,s_packages.change_date,s_packages.details,created_by,modified_by FROM s_packages, s_package_types where package_type = s_package_types.id and s_packages.id = [package_id]
queries.operation_rules: select opr.id, opr.debet, opr.credit, opr.payment_type_id, opr.details, ifnull(b.reg_num, 0) deb_contractor_id, ifnull(a.reg_num, 0) cre_contractor_id, ifnull((select CONCAT_WS(" ", co.name, co.last_name, co.father_name) from h_contractors co where co.id = b.reg_num), 0) deb_full_name, ifnull((select CONCAT_WS(" ", co.name, co.last_name, co.father_name) from h_contractors co where co.id = a.reg_num), 0) cre_full_name, ifnull(b.details, 0) deb_details, ifnull(a.details, 0) cre_details, ifnull(b.bal_out_ncur, 0) deb_debt, ifnull(a.bal_out_ncur, 0) cre_debt from ( select id, case when credit like ('^[%]$') then (select value from s_configuration where name = trim(TRAILING ']$' from trim(LEADING '^[' from credit)) ) else credit end as credit, case when debet like ('^[%]$') then (select value from s_configuration where name = trim(TRAILING ']$' from trim(LEADING '^[' from debet)) ) else debet end as debet, details, payment_type_id from s_operation_rules ) as opr left join f_accounts a on opr.credit = a.account_num left join f_accounts b on opr.debet = b.account_num order by opr.details
queries.operations: select * from (select f_operations.id, h_storages.id storage_id, translations.[lang], s_payment_types.name, f_operations.package_id, h_storages.name storage, f_operations.debet, f_operations.credit, f_operations.amount_ncur, f_operations.amount_fcur, f_operations.currency_code, f_operations.reg_date, f_operations.created_by, f_operations.modified_by, f_operations.status, f_operations.details from f_operations, s_operations_types, s_payment_types, h_storages, translations where f_operations.operation_type_id = s_operations_types.id and f_operations.payment_type_id = s_payment_types.id and f_operations.storage_id = h_storages.id and translations.field_name = s_operations_types.name) l
queries.check_content: SELECT count(*) as exist FROM `contents` where content_name = '[content_name]'
queries.check_Item_strategy: select count(*) as res from s_configuration where name = 'selling_item_strategy' and value = '[ean_number]'
queries.strategy_newest: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT t2.category_id, t1.id, t1.storage_id, t2.item_name,t2.ean_number, t1.price, t1.sell_price, t1.measure_id, t4.name as measure_name, t5.name as storage, t1.limit_cnt, t1.item_id, t3.name category FROM `h_items_info` t1,`h_items` t2, s_item_categories t3, s_measures t4, h_storages t5 WHERE t1.measure_id = t4.id and t1.storage_id = t5.id and t2.category_id = t3.id and t1.item_id = t2.id and t2.ean_number = '[barcode]' and t1.count>0 and t1.storage_id not in ( select value from s_configuration where name in ( 'return_storage_id','cleared_storage_id','main_items_storage_id' ) ) and t2.status != "RE" order by t1.reg_date desc ) l
queries.strategy_123456789: SELECT t2.category_id, t1.id, t1.storage_id, t2.item_name,t2.ean_number, t1.price, t1.sell_price, t1.measure_id, t4.name as measure_name, t5.name as storage, t1.limit_cnt, t1.item_id, t3.name category FROM `h_items_info` t1,`h_items` t2, s_item_categories t3, s_measures t4, h_storages t5 WHERE t1.measure_id = t4.id and t1.storage_id = t5.id and t2.category_id = t3.id and t1.item_id = t2.id and t2.ean_number = '123456789' and t1.count>0 and t1.storage_id not in ( select value from s_configuration where name in ( 'return_storage_id','cleared_storage_id','main_items_storage_id' ) ) and t2.status != "RE" order by t1.sell_price asc limit 0,1
queries.restrict_storage_by_user: LEFT JOIN (select resource_id from grants where id in ( select grant_id from user_grants where user_id in ( select id from users where login ='[login]' ) and grant_id is not null union all select grant_id from role_grants where role_id in (select role_id from user_grants where user_id in (select id from users where login='[login]') and role_id is not null) ) and resource_type = 'h_storages' and grant_type = 'GET') m ON l.storage_id = m.resource_id WHERE m.resource_id is not null or l.storage_id = 0
queries.get_operation_rules: select s_operation_rules.id, s_operation_rules.debet, s_operation_rules.credit, s_operation_rules.payment_type_id, s_operation_rules.operation_type_id, s_operation_rules.details, s_payment_types.name payment_type_name, s_operations_types.name operation_type_name from s_operation_rules left join s_payment_types on s_operation_rules.payment_type_id = s_payment_types.id left join s_operations_types on s_operation_rules.operation_type_id = s_operations_types.id
queries.get_name_and_surname_by_login: select name,surname from users where login = '[login]'
queries.cash_threshold: SELECT * FROM (SELECT c.id, c.account_num, ifnull((select sum(case when debet = c.account_num then amount_ncur when credit = c.account_num then -amount_ncur end) from f_transactions where status != 'RE' and debet = c.account_num or credit = c.account_num),0) balance, a.chart_account_num, c.name, c.details FROM h_cashdesks c, f_accounts a WHERE c.account_num = a.account_num and c.status != "RE" order by c.is_main desc ) l where l.balance > 10000 and account_num like '050%'
queries.cash_threshold_80: SELECT * FROM (SELECT c.id, c.account_num, ifnull((select sum(case when debet = c.account_num then amount_ncur when credit = c.account_num then -amount_ncur end) from f_transactions where status != 'RE' and debet = c.account_num or credit = c.account_num),0) balance, a.chart_account_num, c.name, c.details FROM h_cashdesks c, f_accounts a WHERE c.account_num = a.account_num and c.status != "RE" order by c.is_main desc ) l where l.balance > 8000 and account_num like '050%'
